name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company headquartered in Reno, Nevada, with a strategic land position and royalties across several of Nevada's high-grade historical mining districts. The company's primary focus is the Lapon Canyon Project, where it is earning a 50% interest through a three-year, $5 million exploration program, with an initial resource estimate expected in the first half of 2027. It also holds additional early-stage properties in Nevada and Idaho.
